title: Context Edit Records: overview film
description: Edit records in a side panel. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 44 seconds: Context Edit Records for TYPO3 v14. The list stays open; Page properties too; Every table, no setup. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: In the Records module, every edit opens the full form, and the list is gone.
Context Edit Records opens the form in a side panel, right next to the list.
Click edit on a news article, and the form slides in beside the list.
Pages open their properties in the same panel, with every tab.
It works for every table, here an address from a folder with 299 entries.
Context Edit Records by Georg Ringer. Nothing to configure.
